Card Q&A.a: Yes. It's no longer affected by your opponent's effects as soon as it's suspended, so it can now unsuspend.
Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon is unsuspended, then it's suspended by an opponent's "Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. That Digimon can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase" effect, are effects that prevent unsuspending during the unsuspend phase negated?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it isn't affected. [Security] effects on Security Digimon are treated as Digimon effects, so the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon" effect prevents such effects from affecting this Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect prevent [Security] effects on my opponent's Security Digimon from affecting this Digimon when it's suspended?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing your top or bottom security card, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -9000 DP until the end of their turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, you may place 1 yellow card from your hand as your top or bottom security card.
